The issuer shows leverage stress, with total liabilities exceeding total assets (64,211M vs 54,941M) and consistently negative capital (shareholders’ equity of -9,270M and retained earnings of -9,884M), which weakens balance-sheet resilience. Liquidity is only modestly supported (current ratio 1.09), though positive EBIT/operating income (2,554M) suggests operations still generate earnings. Overall, the balance-sheet condition supports a speculative, elevated-risk rating.  

DECISION: B+
